The corrupted/encrypted WAL file has been repaired and all records have been extracted to `/app/recovered.json`.

### Root Cause
Inspecting [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-q3acjk9x/main.db-wal) revealed that the entire file was XOR-encoded with `0x42` (e.g., the header bytes `75 3d 44 c0` XOR `0x42` yield the standard big-endian SQLite WAL magic number `37 7f 06 82`, and null-padded regions contained `0x42` bytes).

### Changes Made
1. **Decrypted the WAL file**: XORed all bytes of [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-q3acjk9x/main.db-wal) with `0x42` and checkpointed the changes into [main.db](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-q3acjk9x/main.db).
2. **Extracted all 11 records**: Queried the `items` table ordered by `id` (including the updated `apple` and `banana` values and the 6 additional items from the WAL frames) and saved the result to [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-q3acjk9x/recovered.json).
